data.title: Fix bug B0971e4d5a0: Adapter docs-page guard drift: config_store/indexdb/managed_files have no docs/ddflow/adapters/<...

evidence.note: CONFIRMED: no machine check enforces docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md. Probe: uv run python -c 'P.discover(A) families - docs/*.md stems' => missing {config_store,indexdb,managed_files} before the fix, empty after adding the three pages + tests/test_ports_contract_docs.py. The new guard test_every_port_family_has_a_docs_page FAILS on unfixed code naming config_store and PASSES with the pages present.

r-adapters (project priority 100, globs ddflow/**): a family is its <family>.py port + fakes/<family>.py + conformance + docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md. This fix adds the three missing pages (config_store, indexdb, managed_files) and a generic doc-exists guard; no new port, no shared-file edit (no ports.py/fakes/__init__/ports_contract/ARCHITECTURE.md touched). r-core-pure respected: the pages only document the existing ConfigStore-split (default in services, port in adapters).

Commit ebdc82556: added docs/ddflow/adapters/{config_store,indexdb,managed_files}.md and tests/test_ports_contract_docs.py::test_every_port_family_has_a_docs_page. Guard PASSES with all pages present and FAILS on unfixed code naming config_store.

ruff check + ruff format --check clean on tests/test_ports_contract_docs.py (uv run). The three .md pages follow the sibling page format (port/default adapter/fake/conformance + README link; clock.md/toml.md). No Python behaviour code changed.

Hunted the classic modes on a docs+guard change. Vacuous-truth (empty P.discover -> vacuous pass) is already excluded: test_ports_contract.py::test_the_ports_are_found_by_scanning_not_listed asserts discovery non-empty. The guard is a set difference with no off-by-one (stems vs stem sets), no config drop, no torn-tail, no dead knob.

No logic duplicated: the three docs pages are prose; one new test. The one-line _family() helper (cls.__module__.rsplit('.',1)[1]) also exists in tests/test_ports_contract.py and is kept local here because that file is leased to lane5-kilo (fix-B4e431e0082); it does not duplicate shipped production logic.
